chrome_hint: eBay AU sold + Terapeak: 'antique 15ct gold citrine ring', '18ct gold citrine signet ring chased', 'vintage gold dress ring emerald cut citrine bezel'. Also Noble Numismatics jewellery results (recent sales, 'citrine ring 15ct'), Gowans/Leonard Joel/Lawsons sold 'gold citrine dress ring', LiveAuctioneers and Invaluable 'Edwardian/Art Deco 15ct citrine ring chased shoulders'. Compare to scrap value: need weight in grams (ask at viewing) times current 15ct/18ct gold price.
viewing_check: Weigh the ring (grams) and look for the carat stamp inside the shank (750, 15ct, 9ct) plus any maker mark; check the stone is glass/synthetic vs citrine (scratches, bubbles, pavilion), check shank wear/thin spots and ring size. Gold weight is what sets the price.
